leaves.name: DCMA 14-Point Schedule Health Audit
acceptance: Calculates 14 industry-standard metrics (logic, leads, lags, float, etc.) against current schedule.
Generates a downloadable .txt summary of audit results.
leaves.evidence: runDcma implements all 14 checks. DcmaPanel provides UI and download function.
gaps: No unit tests for the complex check logic.

leaves.name: Time Impact Analysis (TIA) Frag-net Generator
acceptance: Produces ASCII frag-net, narrative (NJDOT 108-03), and CSV fragment for P6 import.
leaves.evidence: buildTia exists and generates the requested artifacts but lacks a UI entry point in ScheduleWorkspace.
gaps: No UI surface to invoke buildTia.

leaves.name: NJDOT Compliance & Health Strip
acceptance: Real-time display of negative lags, open-ended tasks, CPM cycles, and missing NJDOT M-codes.
leaves.evidence: ComplianceStrip calculates and displays these metrics in real-time at the bottom of the workspace.
gaps: Milestone detection depends on exact prefix match (starts with M###).

leaves.name: Baseline vs Forecast Variance Analysis (compareProgress)
acceptance: Compares current schedule against a captured baseline.
Calculates SPI, CPI (duration proxy), and finish variance.
leaves.evidence: compareProgress logic is implemented but not exposed in any UI panel.
gaps: No UI surface exposing SPI/CPI or slipping activities table.

leaves.name: Resident Engineer (RE) Feedback Memo
acceptance: Generates a structured plain-text memo recommending ACCEPT, ACCEPT WITH CONDITIONS, or REJECT based on DCMA results.
leaves.evidence: buildReMemo generates a detailed memorandum with hard-blocker vs advisory categorization.
gaps: Unwired to the 'Download Memo' button in the UI (DcmaPanel currently only exports raw results).

docDrift.actual: The user requested Stream 13 to cover DCMA and Schedule Quality; the existing markdown doc 13-data-export-and-interoperability.md conflicts with this numbering.

docDrift.claim: TIA generator and Progress variance are listed as capabilities.
docDrift.actual: Both are implemented in the analysis library but lack UI surfaces in the production app.
